thread:
Alex (sales): Heads-up — POC with ACME just hit a flaky failure: function-calls in JSON mode sometimes returning 200 with empty body, then later 429s. Customer is blocked on demo tonight. Can we swarm? :eyes:
Priya (solutions): Ugh. Which model/variant and SDK? Any reproducible payload?
Alex (sales): Using redwood/gpt-neo-32k-quant (customer pinned). Node SDK via our JS client, streaming disabled. Payload is a function call with name `create_order` and JSON schema. Happens after a few successful calls, then errors.
Tom (eng-runtime): Can you paste a minimal request and the raw response (headers + body)? Also need runtime logs around the 429s. 429 could be throttling or upstream.
Alex (sales): Minimal request pasted below:
```json
{ "model": "redwood/gpt-neo-32k-quant", "mode": "json", "function": "create_order", "input": { "items": [...] }}
```
Response header snippet they got when 429: `x-rw-quota: 0/1000`, `x-rw-request-id: a1b2c3` and body is `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded"}`. But earlier the empty-body case returned HTTP 200 with `{}`.
Priya (solutions): Two separate probs: quota throttle vs JSON-mode parse/validation. Empty `{}` suggests the function calling handler dropped structured output — maybe schema mismatch or truncation. Did they hit token limit/truncation?
Jorge (acct-mgr): Customer is on a trial dedicated quota; we set a low burst threshold. Could be hitting trial cap. I can temporarily lift burst cap for an hour if you want to reproduce.
Tom (eng-runtime): Yes please, Jorge — bump burst to 5x for an hour and ping when done. Meanwhile Alex, paste the SDK request/response with debug logs (set RW_LOG=debug) and include `x-rw-request-id` for each failing call.
Alex (sales): Bumped by Jorge now. Attaching two request ids they saw: a1b2c3 (429), a1b2d4 (200, empty body). I'll get debug logs from customer.
Maria (security): Quick flag — ACME requested answers for our data residency clause in the SQA. If we escalate config changes, they need confirmation that logs won't include PII. We should redact before sharing.
Priya (solutions): Good call. Ask ACME to scrub PII; we only need the request ids and server-side runtime logs (no customer payload).
Tom (eng-runtime): Got a trimmed log snippet from support (redacted):
```
[2026-03-20T21:02:11Z] req=a1b2c3 model=redwood/gpt-neo-32k-quant seq=1 tokens=450 status=429 reason=quota_exceeded
[2026-03-20T21:02:12Z] req=a1b2d4 model=redwood/gpt-neo-32k-quant seq=2 tokens=512 status=200 body_len=2
[2026-03-20T21:02:12Z] handler=fncall parser=struct_out error=validation_truncated
```
Tom (eng-runtime): That `validation_truncated` is the clue — tokenizer hit a cut and the schema parser discarded output, producing `{}`. We need to either increase model max tokens or enable chunked/streaming so the function-caller can assemble full JSON.
Priya (solutions): For immediate workaround, enable streaming + `max_output_tokens: 1024` in the request and set `json_mode: strict` to fail loud rather than return empty. Also recommend smaller system prompt and prompt engineering to keep outputs within limit.
Alex (sales): I'll relay that. Customer is worried about 429s though — Jorge, did burst apply?
Jorge (acct-mgr): Burst increase is live. The 429s in the log were before bump. If they get another 429 after bump, we escalate.
deploy-bot: Deployment note — routing policy for the trial pool currently has per-tenant qps=2. Temporary override to qps=10 applied at 1805010050 by Jorge.
Maria (security): For sharing logs externally, provide them a redaction script and an NDA. Also note: VPC/private customers get longer retention redaction options if they want.
Tom (eng-runtime): Action items: (1) Alex ask customer to enable streaming + set max_output_tokens=1024 and retry, (2) collect any new `x-rw-request-id` if 429 persists, (3) I will add a parser-level metric to surface `validation_truncated` counts per-tenant.
Priya (solutions): I'll prepare a short how-to snippet for the customer (streaming + example payload) and a checklist for the SQA items Maria mentioned.
Alex (sales): Thanks team — on it. I'll update ACME and post results here. :thumbsup:
